slides.title: I clean while the kettle boils. Here's what fits in 3 minutes.
Kettle: unload the top rack
slides.body: Cups and bowls only. Usually done before the click.

slides.title: Microwave: wipe one shelf
slides.body: Two minutes of reheating is two minutes of wiping.

slides.title: Shower warming up: clear the sink
slides.body: Toothbrush back, cap on, quick wipe.

slides.title: Coffee brewing: sort today's mail
slides.body: Recycle the junk while it drips. Keep the rest in one spot.

slides.title: Bath running: grab the floor clothes
slides.body: Into the hamper before the tub fills.

slides.title: The best time to clean is the time you were already standing there.
Want the rest of the tiny habits?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
